Um interface.question: It is the interface between the mobile station (MS) and the _____ transceiver station (BTS)
Um interface.fact: It is the interface between the mobile station (MS) and the Base transceiver station (BTS).

Um interface.subject: Telecom & Postal
Um interface.question: It is called Um because it is the mobile analog to the U interface of _____
Um interface.fact: It is called Um because it is the mobile analog to the U interface of ISDN.

Um interface.subject: Telecom & Postal
Um interface.question: Um can also support _____ packet-oriented communication
Um interface.fact: Um can also support GPRS packet-oriented communication.

Um interface.subject: Telecom & Postal
Um interface.question: There are three sublayers: _____
Um interface.fact: There are three sublayers: Radiomodem.

Um interface.subject: Telecom & Postal
Um interface.question: GSM uses _____ to subdivide each radio channel into as many as 16 traffic channels or as many as 64 control channels
Um interface.fact: GSM uses TDMA to subdivide each radio channel into as many as 16 traffic channels or as many as 64 control channels. Um on the physical channel has 26 TDMA frames each frame consisting of 114 info bits each.

Um interface.subject: Telecom & Postal
Um interface.question: Um on the physical channel has 26 _____ frames each frame consisting of 114 info bits each
Um interface.fact: GSM uses TDMA to subdivide each radio channel into as many as 16 traffic channels or as many as 64 control channels. Um on the physical channel has 26 TDMA frames each frame consisting of 114 info bits each.

Um interface.subject: Telecom & Postal
Um interface.question: The length of 26 _____ frame also called Multi-frame is 120 ms apart
Um interface.fact: Um on the physical channel has 26 TDMA frames each frame consisting of 114 info bits each. The length of 26 TDMA frame also called Multi-frame is 120 ms apart.

Um interface.subject: Telecom & Postal
Um interface.question: The standard defines several bands ranging from 400 MHz to _____ MHz
Um interface.fact: The standard defines several bands ranging from 400 MHz to 1990 MHz.

Um interface.question: Within the BTS, these ARFCNs are given arbitrary carrier indexes C0..Cn-1, with C0 designated as a _____ and always operated at constant power
Um interface.fact: Within the BTS, these ARFCNs are given arbitrary carrier indexes C0..Cn-1, with C0 designated as a Beacon Channel and always operated at constant power.

Um interface.subject: Telecom & Postal
Um interface.question: The capacity associated with a single timeslot on a single _____ is called a physical channel (PCH) and referred to as "CnTm" where n is a carrier index and m is a timeslot index (0-7)
Um interface.fact: The capacity associated with a single timeslot on a single ARFCN is called a physical channel (PCH) and called "CnTm" where n is a carrier index and m is a timeslot index (0-7).

Um interface.subject: Telecom & Postal
Um interface.question: The most commonly used burst is the _____ (NB)
Um interface.fact: The most commonly used burst is the Normal Burst (NB).

Um interface.subject: Telecom & Postal
Um interface.question: The random access burst (_____) has an extended guard period to allow it to be transmitted with incomplete timing acquisition
Um interface.fact: The random access burst (RACH) has an extended guard period to allow it to be transmitted with incomplete timing acquisition.

Um interface.subject: Telecom & Postal
Um interface.question: Burst formats are described in GSM 05.02 _____ 5.2
Um interface.fact: Burst formats are described in GSM 05.02 Section 5.2.

Um interface.subject: Telecom & Postal
Um interface.question: One logical channel constitute of 8 burst periods (or physical channels) which is called a _____
Um interface.fact: One logical channel constitute of 8 burst periods (or physical channels) which is called a Frame. Traffic channel multiplexing follows a 26-frame (0.12 second) cycle called a "multiframe".

Um interface.subject: Telecom & Postal
Um interface.question: The C0T0 physical channel carries the SCH, which encodes the timing state of the BTS to facilitate synchronization to the _____ pattern
Um interface.fact: The C0T0 physical channel carries the SCH, which encodes the timing state of the BTS to facilitate synchronization to the TDMA pattern.

Um interface.subject: Telecom & Postal
Um interface.question: GSM timing is driven by the serving BTS through the SCH and _____
Um interface.fact: GSM timing is driven by the serving BTS through the SCH and FCCH.

Um interface.question: BTSs in the GSM network can be asynchronous and all timing requirements in the GSM standard can be derived from a stratum-3 _____
Um interface.fact: BTSs in the GSM network can be asynchronous and all timing requirements in the GSM standard can be derived from a stratum-3 OCXO.

Um interface.subject: Telecom & Postal
Um interface.question: As a general rule, each GSM channel uses a block parity code (usually a _____ code), a rate-1/2, 4th-order convolutional code and a 4-burst or 8-burst interleaver
Um interface.fact: As a general rule, each GSM channel uses a block parity code (usually a Fire code), a rate-1/2, 4th-order convolutional code and a 4-burst or 8-burst interleaver.

Um interface.subject: Telecom & Postal
Um interface.question: Notable exceptions are the synchronization channel (SCH) and random access channel (_____) that use single-burst transmissions and thus have no interleavers
Um interface.fact: Notable exceptions are the synchronization channel (SCH) and random access channel (RACH) that use single-burst transmissions and thus have no interleavers.

Um interface.subject: Telecom & Postal
Um interface.question: On channels with 4-burst interleaving (_____, CCCH, SDCCH, SACCH), these 456 bits are interleaved into 4 radio bursts with 114 payload bits per burst
Um interface.fact: On channels with 4-burst interleaving (BCCH, CCCH, SDCCH, SACCH), these 456 bits are interleaved into 4 radio bursts with 114 payload bits per burst.

Um interface.subject: Telecom & Postal
Um interface.question: Interleaving algorithms for the most common traffic and control channels are described in GSM 05.03 _____ 3.1.3, 3.2.3 and 4.1.4
Um interface.fact: Interleaving algorithms for the most common traffic and control channels are described in GSM 05.03 Sections 3.1.3, 3.2.3 and 4.1.4.

Um interface.subject: Telecom & Postal
Um interface.question: It is normally terminated in the _____ (VLR) or Home Location Register (HLR)
Um interface.fact: It is normally terminated in the Visitor Location Register (VLR) or Home Location Register (HLR).

Um interface.fact: Broadly speaking, non-GPRS Um logical channels fall into three categories: traffic channels, dedicated control channels and non-dedicated control channels.

Um interface.subject: Telecom & Postal
Um interface.question: Traffic channels use 8-burst(_____) diagonal interleaving with a new block starting on every fourth burst and any given burst containing bits from two different traffic frames
Um interface.fact: Traffic channels use 8-burst(Break) diagonal interleaving with a new block starting on every fourth burst and any given burst containing bits from two different traffic frames.

Um interface.subject: Telecom & Postal
Um interface.question: All traffic channels use a 26-multiframe _____ structure
Um interface.fact: All traffic channels use a 26-multiframe TDMA structure.

Um interface.fact: This channel is normally used with the GSM 06.10 Full Rate, GSM 06.60 Enhanced Full Rate or GSM 06.90 Adaptive Multi-Rate speech codec.

Um interface.subject: Telecom & Postal
Um interface.question: It can also be used for fax and _____
Um interface.fact: It can also be used for fax and Circuit Switched Data.

Um interface.fact: This channel is normally used with the GSM 06.20 Half Rate or GSM 06.90 Adaptive Multi-Rate speech codec.

Um interface.subject: Telecom & Postal
Um interface.question: The _____ uses 4-burst block interleaving in a 51-multiframe
Um interface.fact: Up to eight SDCCHs can be time-multiplexed onto a single physical channel. The SDCCH uses 4-burst block interleaving in a 51-multiframe.

Um interface.subject: Telecom & Postal
Um interface.question: The _____ is a blank-and-burst channel that operates by stealing bursts from its associated traffic channel
Um interface.fact: The FACCH is a blank-and-burst channel that operates by stealing bursts from its associated traffic channel. Bursts that carry FACCH data are distinguished from traffic bursts by stealing bits at each end of the midamble.

Um interface.subject: Telecom & Postal
Um interface.question: Bursts that carry _____ data are distinguished from traffic bursts by stealing bits at each end of the midamble
Um interface.fact: The FACCH is a blank-and-burst channel that operates by stealing bursts from its associated traffic channel. Bursts that carry FACCH data are distinguished from traffic bursts by stealing bits at each end of the midamble.

Um interface.subject: Telecom & Postal
Um interface.question: The _____ is used for in-call signaling, including call disconnect, handover and the later stages of call setup
Um interface.fact: The FACCH is a blank-and-burst channel that operates by stealing bursts from its associated traffic channel. Bursts that carry FACCH data are distinguished from traffic bursts by stealing bits at each end of the midamble.

Um interface.subject: Telecom & Postal
Um interface.question: It has a payload data rate of 9.2 kbit/s when paired with a full-rate channel (_____/F) and 4.6 kbit/s when paired with a half-rate channel (FACCH/H)
Um interface.fact: The FACCH is a blank-and-burst channel that operates by stealing bursts from its associated traffic channel.

Um interface.subject: Telecom & Postal
Um interface.question: The _____ uses the same interleaving and multiframe structure as its host TCH
Um interface.fact: Bursts that carry FACCH data are distinguished from traffic bursts by stealing bits at each end of the midamble. The FACCH is used for in-call signaling, including call disconnect, handover and the later stages of call setup.

Um interface.subject: Telecom & Postal
Um interface.question: The _____ can also be used for in-call delivery of SMS
Um interface.fact: The SACCH can also be used for in-call delivery of SMS. The SACCH uses 4-burst block interleaving and the same multiframe type as its host TCH or SDCCH.

Um interface.subject: Telecom & Postal
Um interface.question: The _____ uses 4-burst block interleaving and the same multiframe type as its host TCH or SDCCH
Um interface.fact: The SACCH can also be used for in-call delivery of SMS. The SACCH uses 4-burst block interleaving and the same multiframe type as its host TCH or SDCCH.

Um interface.subject: Telecom & Postal
Um interface.question: The _____ and RACH together form the medium access mechanism for Um
Um interface.fact: The AGCH and RACH together form the medium access mechanism for Um.

Um interface.subject: Telecom & Postal
Um interface.question: So there are 5 _____ frames in a 51 frame multiframe
Um interface.fact: FCCH will repeat on every 0th, 10th, 20th, 30th and 40th frames of the 51 frame multiframe. So there are 5 FCCH frames in a 51 frame multiframe.

Um interface.subject: Telecom & Postal
Um interface.question: The _____ is a shared channel on which the mobile stations transmit random access bursts to request channel assignments from the BTS
Um interface.fact: The RACH is a shared channel on which the mobile stations transmit random access bursts to request channel assignments from the BTS.

Um interface.subject: Telecom & Postal
Um interface.question: The allowed combinations for single-slot systems are listed in GSM 05.02 _____ 6.4.1
Um interface.fact: The allowed combinations for single-slot systems are listed in GSM 05.02 Section 6.4.1. These restrictions are intended to exclude non-sensical BTS configurations and are described in GSM 05.02 Section 6.5.

Um interface.subject: Telecom & Postal
Um interface.question: These restrictions are intended to exclude non-sensical BTS configurations and are described in GSM 05.02 _____ 6.5
Um interface.fact: The allowed combinations for single-slot systems are listed in GSM 05.02 Section 6.4.1. These restrictions are intended to exclude non-sensical BTS configurations and are described in GSM 05.02 Section 6.5.

Um interface.subject: Telecom & Postal
Um interface.question: The most common combinations are: _____ I: TCH/F + FACCH/F + SACCH
Um interface.fact: The allowed combinations for single-slot systems are listed in GSM 05.02 Section 6.4.1. Additionally, only certain of these combinations are allowed on certain timeslots or carriers and only certain sets of combinations can coexist in a given BTS.

Um interface.subject: Telecom & Postal
Um interface.question: Combination II: TCH/H + _____/H + SACCH
Um interface.fact: The most common combinations are: Combination I: TCH/F + FACCH/F + SACCH. Combination II: TCH/H + FACCH/H + SACCH.

Um interface.subject: Telecom & Postal
Um interface.question: Combination III: 2 TCH/H + 2 _____/H + 2 SACCH
Um interface.fact: Combination II: TCH/H + FACCH/H + SACCH. Combination III: 2 TCH/H + 2 FACCH/H + 2 SACCH.

Um interface.subject: Telecom & Postal
Um interface.question: Combination IV: _____ + SCH + BCCH + CCCH
Um interface.fact: Combination IV: FCCH + SCH + BCCH + CCCH. Combination V: FCCH + SCH + BCCH + CCCH + 4 SDCCH + 2 SACCH.

Um interface.subject: Telecom & Postal
Um interface.question: Combination V: _____ + SCH + BCCH + CCCH + 4 SDCCH + 2 SACCH
Um interface.fact: Combination IV: FCCH + SCH + BCCH + CCCH. Combination V: FCCH + SCH + BCCH + CCCH + 4 SDCCH + 2 SACCH.

Um interface.subject: Telecom & Postal
Um interface.question: [(5x1)+(5x1)+(1x4)+(3x4)+(4x4)+(2x4)+1idle=51frame multiframe] This is the typical C0T0 combination for small cells, which allows the BTS to trade unnecessary _____ capacity for a pool of 4 SDCCHs
Um interface.fact: Combination V: FCCH + SCH + BCCH + CCCH + 4 SDCCH + 2 SACCH. [(5x1)+(5x1)+(1x4)+(3x4)+(4x4)+(2x4)+1idle=51frame multiframe] This is the typical C0T0 combination for small cells, which allows the BTS to trade unnecessary CCCH capacity for a pool of 4 SDCCHs.

Um interface.subject: Telecom & Postal
Um interface.question: Combination VI: _____ + CCCH
Um interface.fact: Combination V: FCCH + SCH + BCCH + CCCH + 4 SDCCH + 2 SACCH. Combination VI: BCCH + CCCH.

Um interface.subject: Telecom & Postal
Um interface.question: This combination is used to provide additional _____ capacity in large cells
Um interface.fact: [(5x1)+(5x1)+(1x4)+(3x4)+(4x4)+(2x4)+1idle=51frame multiframe] This is the typical C0T0 combination for small cells, which allows the BTS to trade unnecessary CCCH capacity for a pool of 4 SDCCHs. Combination VI: BCCH + CCCH.

Um interface.subject: Telecom & Postal
Um interface.question: Combination VII: 8 _____ + 4 SACCH.[(8x4)+(4x4)+3idle=51frame multiframe] This combination is used to provide additional SDCCH capacity in medium and large cells
Um interface.fact: Combination VII: 8 SDCCH + 4 SACCH.[(8x4)+(4x4)+3idle=51frame multiframe] This combination is used to provide additional SDCCH capacity in medium and large cells.

Um interface.question: All of these transactions are described in GSM 04.08 _____ 3-7
Um interface.fact: All of these transactions are described in GSM 04.08 Sections 3-7.

Um interface.subject: Telecom & Postal
Um interface.question: The Um radio resource establishment procedure is defined in GSM 04.08 _____ 3.3 and this is the basic medium access procedure for Um
Um interface.fact: All of these transactions are described in GSM 04.08 Sections 3-7. The Um radio resource establishment procedure is defined in GSM 04.08 Section 3.3 and this is the basic medium access procedure for Um.

Um interface.subject: Telecom & Postal
Um interface.question: This procedure uses the _____ (PCH and AGCH) as a unicast downlink and the RACH as a shared uplink
Um interface.fact: This procedure uses the CCCH (PCH and AGCH) as a unicast downlink and the RACH as a shared uplink.

Um interface.question: In the simplest form, the steps of the transaction are: _____
Um interface.fact: In the simplest form, the steps of the transaction are: Paging. The network sends a RR Paging Request message (GSM 04.08 Sections 9.1.22-9.1.23) over the PCH, using the subscriber's IMSI or TMSI as an address.

Um interface.subject: Telecom & Postal
Um interface.question: The network sends a RR _____ message (GSM 04.08 Sections 9.1.22-9.1.23) over the PCH, using the subscriber's IMSI or TMSI as an address
Um interface.fact: The network sends a RR Paging Request message (GSM 04.08 Sections 9.1.22-9.1.23) over the PCH, using the subscriber's IMSI or TMSI as an address.

Um interface.subject: Telecom & Postal
Um interface.question: GSM does not allow paging by IMEI (GSM 04.08 _____ 9.1.22.3 as exception to the definition in 10.5.1.4)
Um interface.fact: The network sends a RR Paging Request message (GSM 04.08 Sections 9.1.22-9.1.23) over the PCH, using the subscriber's IMSI or TMSI as an address. GSM does not allow paging by IMEI (GSM 04.08 Section 9.1.22.3 as exception to the definition in 10.5.1.4).

Um interface.subject: Telecom & Postal
Um interface.question: The mobile station sends a burst on the _____
Um interface.fact: The mobile station sends a burst on the RACH.

Um interface.subject: Telecom & Postal
Um interface.question: This burst encodes an 8-bit transaction tag and the _____ of the serving BTS
Um interface.fact: This burst encodes an 8-bit transaction tag and the BSIC of the serving BTS.

Um interface.subject: Telecom & Postal
Um interface.question: In L3, this tag is presented as the RR _____ message (GSM 04.08 9.1.8)

Um interface.subject: Telecom & Postal
Um interface.question: The mobile also records the _____ clock state at the time the RACH burst is transmitted
Um interface.fact: The mobile also records the TDMA clock state at the time the RACH burst is transmitted. This message is addressed to the MS by inclusion of the 8-bit tag from the corresponding RACH burst and a time-stamp indicating the TDMA clock state when the RACH burst was received.

Um interface.subject: Telecom & Postal
Um interface.question: This message is addressed to the MS by inclusion of the 8-bit tag from the corresponding _____ burst and a time-stamp indicating the TDMA clock state when the RACH burst was received
Um interface.fact: The mobile also records the TDMA clock state at the time the RACH burst is transmitted. This message is addressed to the MS by inclusion of the 8-bit tag from the corresponding RACH burst and a time-stamp indicating the TDMA clock state when the RACH burst was received.

Um interface.subject: Telecom & Postal
Um interface.question: On the AGCH, the network sends the RR _____ message (GSM 04.08 Section 9.1.18) for a dedicated channel, usually an SDCCH
Um interface.fact: On the AGCH, the network sends the RR Immediate Assignment message (GSM 04.08 Section 9.1.18) for a dedicated channel, usually an SDCCH. If no dedicated channel is available for assignment, the BTS can instead respond with the RR Immediate Assignment Reject message, which is similarly addressed and contains a hold-off time for the next access attempt.

Um interface.subject: Telecom & Postal
Um interface.question: If no dedicated channel is available for assignment, the BTS can instead respond with the RR _____ message, which is similarly addressed and contains a hold-off time for the next access attempt
Um interface.fact: If no dedicated channel is available for assignment, the BTS can instead respond with the RR Immediate Assignment Reject message, which is similarly addressed and contains a hold-off time for the next access attempt.

Um interface.subject: Telecom & Postal
Um interface.question: Note that there is a small but non-zero probability that two MSs send identical _____ bursts at the same time in step 2
Um interface.fact: If the RACH burst of step 2 is not answered with an assignment or assignment reject in step 3 within a given timeout period (usually on the order of 0.5 second), the handset will repeat step 2 after a small random delay. Note that there is a small but non-zero probability that two MSs send identical RACH bursts at the same time in step 2.

Um interface.subject: Telecom & Postal
Um interface.question: If these _____ bursts arrive at the BTS with comparable power, the resulting sum of radio signals will not be demodulable and both MSs will move to step 4
Um interface.fact: If the RACH burst of step 2 is not answered with an assignment or assignment reject in step 3 within a given timeout period (usually on the order of 0.5 second), the handset will repeat step 2 after a small random delay. Note that there is a small but non-zero probability that two MSs send identical RACH bursts at the same time in step 2.

Um interface.subject: Telecom & Postal
Um interface.question: However, if there is a sufficient difference in power, the BTS will see and answer the more powerful _____ burst
